Name: Pusheen Plushie Blind Boxes
Author: AvatarKitten
Description:
Do you like to hoard items in video games? Collect cute things? Are you a fan of Pusheen the Cat? Then this mod is for you!

This mod currently adds in 9 different blind boxes each containing 6 unique Pusheen the Cat plushies. Each box contains 5 normal plushies, and one rare plushie! The blind boxes can be opened by a Magic Pusheen Crystal, a special item that can be crafted with a recipe purchased from Marnie. Marnie will also sell the blind boxes, stocking 5 of each box per day, but you can also find boxes in fishing chests and garbage cans! Some boxes are seasonal, meaning they only appear in one season, making them rarer!

What can you do with these plushies?

Aside from displaying them on tables for some cute decor, these plushies can be sold for a small profit, or gifted to villagers. Most villagers will be neutral to them, but some villagers like them more, or even love them! However, some villagers don't like them, so be careful!

[b]THESE MODS ARE REQUIRED FOR THIS MOD TO WORK!!!

Future Plans: more ways to obtain blind boxes, and new blind boxes with new plushies!

This is my first mod I've ever made for any game, so please excuse any bugs, let me know if you find any so I can attempt to fix them!

Credits:
This mod was heavily inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35850]JojaPop Labubu Mod[/url] by AirynS, the blind box mechanic within this mod inspired me to create my own blind box mod.

All pixel art inspired by existing Pusheen the Cat plushies, and was made by me with help from my friend, Eden.

The frameworks of Content Patcher by Pathoschild and Item Extensions by mistyspring helped make this mod possible. 

Thank you to the Stardew Valley Wiki and Stardew Modding Wiki for many tutorials that helped me learn to make this mod.

Huge thank you to the modding channel in the Stardew Valley Discord, everyone was a huge help with troubleshooting. A special thank you to Selph/zombifier in particular, for tons of help troubleshooting and guiding me with some of the more difficult parts of creating this mod.
